name: Proto-Tai-Kadai (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Tai-Kadai (Kra-Dai) is the reconstructed ancestor of the Tai-Kadai family, including the Southwestern Tai varieties Thai and Lao. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Pittayaporn, P.
sources.title: The Phonology of Proto-Tai
sources.notes: Reference for Tai reconstruction (structural node only).

location.notes: Glottolog's computed centroid for the Tai-Kadai family — a summary of a whole clade's range, not a place anyone speaks.
